statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail steps back to 22% and returns to the watch band after the overnight advance was rejected beneath its named 31,094.75 pivot on a measurable retracement.
recommendation: Tail has fallen back below the 25% block threshold. The preceding assessment named rejection beneath 31,094.75 as the condition for a step back into the watch band, and that condition has now been met: price has retraced about 188 points from the 31,147.75 high on rising turnover, which removes all three of the amplifiers that had been observed together. Mapped policy state is WATCH. The 12:00-15:00Z danger window covering jobless claims, Fed's Barkin, the cash open, the final manufacturing PMI and ISM manufacturing remains the hour range where observed post-release continuation would warrant renewed escalation.
headline: NQ retraces 188 points from 31,147.75 and is rejected back under the 31,094.75 pivot, easing Tail to 22% as oil and the long end both turn higher
body: December E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures trade 30,960.00, up 261.25 points or 0.85% from the 30,698.75 settle, after retracing roughly 188 points from the overnight high at 31,147.75. The decisive change this hour is that the advance has been rejected back beneath the 31,094.75 pivot that the preceding assessment identified as the marker of genuine uptrend resumption, and now sits about 135 points below it. Two further sources corroborate the level at 30,950.50, up 0.82%, and 30,947.75, up 0.81%, on roughly 84,253 contracts. Turnover has risen to 84.66k from 68.64k an hour earlier, so the retracement arrived on improving rather than deteriorating liquidity, which is the signature of a functioning two-way market rather than a thin-book reversal. All three amplifiers observed in the preceding hour have now been removed together: the acceptance above the named pivot has been lost, price no longer holds the session extreme, and the four-hour sequence of extension without a retracement test has ended. The advance still has an identifiable driver in Micron's fiscal fourth quarter, which delivered adjusted earnings of 33.42 dollars per share against roughly 31.16 to 31.61 expected on 54.23 billion dollars of revenue, with first-quarter revenue guided to 61.5 billion dollars and earnings to 38.15 dollars against a 36.02 consensus, and that lifted Japan's Nikkei 225 by 2.8% to 68,606.81 with the Kospi adding 1.2%. Cross-assets have now turned from withholding confirmation to actively conflicting. The 2-year sits at 4.92%, the 5-year 5.12%, the 10-year 5.32% and the 30-year 5.65%, all higher on the day after being marginally lower an hour earlier, with the 10-year and 30-year still at their highest since 2002 on energy-related inflation and fiscal concern. WTI has reversed to 91.61 dollars, up 1.32%, from 89.52 dollars down 0.99%, with a second source at 92.18 dollars up 1.95% and Brent at 99.64 dollars up 1.65%, on the unresolved US-Iran impasse over the Strait of Hormuz set against resuming regional exports including Saudi Arabia's Yanbu restart. The VIX reference remains 16.34 with the cash market closed, and the completed cash session continues to argue that reversion is intact: NDX closed 30,408.50, up 0.23%, at the exact low of a 30,408.50 to 30,630.45 range and therefore a full intraday fade. August core PCE at 0.2% monthly and 3.0% annually against 3.3% expected has cut October Fed hike odds to roughly 35% from about 50%. Firmer oil and a higher long end against fading equities is a risk-negative cross-asset mix, but it is one that raises Stress rather than Tail while the equity price path itself is mean-reverting. Stress therefore firms to 74% while Tail eases three points to 22% and returns to the watch band, mapping the policy state to WATCH. Shared Finviz context was collected 2026-09-29T23:14:22Z with partial status, so at roughly 32 hours old it is stale under the 90-minute freshness rule and was not used; this assessment rests entirely on independent current research.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding hourly slots carry published Claude assessments. Tail sat at 15-16% through the European and early US hours of 30 September with the mode mixed, stepped into the watch band at 20% from 12:00Z as the US data block and the long-end selloff developed, and peaked at 23% around 15:00-16:00Z. It held a 20-22% range through the US afternoon and the early Asian session, then firmed steadily from 20% at 00:00Z through 21%, 22% and 23% to 24% at 05:00Z and 25% at 06:00Z as NQ printed successive fresh overnight highs and accepted above its named pivot, with the mode turning trend-up in the final two slots. Stress stayed in the high band throughout, between 65% and 73%, and Confidence held 85-88%.
outlookSummary: The mapped danger window is unchanged at 12:00-15:00Z, covering initial and continuing jobless claims at 12:30Z against a 201K consensus after 197K, Fed's Barkin at 13:05Z, the 13:30Z cash open, the final S&P Global manufacturing PMI at 13:45Z and ISM manufacturing plus August construction spending at 14:00Z with ISM consensus at 54.8 after 54.6. Forecast Tail opens at 22% in the watch band and eases to 21% across the mid-European hours where two-way liquidity would normally extend the retracement, firms to 23% as the claims hour opens and peaks at the top of the watch band at 24% across the 13:00-14:00Z cash-open and ISM hours where Stress tops at 78%. It decays to 20-22% through the US afternoon, the cash close and the late evening, then firms marginally to 21-23% through the Asian session and the European pre-open as positioning concentrates ahead of the September employment report at 12:30Z on 2 October, which falls outside this forecast window. The forecast peak deliberately stops at the top of the watch band rather than crossing into the block band, because a scheduled event stack is a checkpoint and the observed path has not yet supplied the amplifiers. A renewed upward reassessment would require observed evidence rather than schedule: shallow or failed retracements after the cash open, repeated extension following a failed pullback, a reclaim of 31,094.75 and the 31,147.75 high without an intervening retracement, or the long end finally realigning behind the equity move. A deeper retracement into the 30,812.75 shelf, or containment within the 30,812.75 to 31,094.75 band through the US session, would support a further step down within the watch band.
